$description: Follow Me Therapy design tokens. THE single source: edit here (or in Figma via Tokens Studio), then run python3 tools/build_tokens.py.

purple.$description: Primary brand colour: buttons, links, highlights, illustrations. White text on it 7.1:1; as text on paper 7.1:1. On purple-tint use purple-dark or purple-ink for text. AAA: darkened from #6b4ef0 in Oct 2026.

purple-dark.$description: Pressed/hover purple, and purple text on purple-tint where extra weight is wanted. AAA: darkened from #5a3fd6 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

purple-ink.$description: Text and icons inside purple-tint chips and tags (6.8:1 on purple-tint). AAA: darkened from #4b34c9 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

purple-tint.$description: Lilac ground. Hero sections, the 'Ages' chip, info-note backgrounds, worksheet headers.

purple-line.$description: Border of purple chips and panels, hairlines, dotted write-on lines on worksheets.

teal.$description: Second brand colour. Tick circles, telehealth, 'how it works' steps. White text on it passes (5.1:1). AAA: darkened from #007a8a in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

teal-ink.$description: Text and icons inside teal-tint chips (6.4:1). AAA: darkened from #00606d in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

teal-tint.$description: Mint ground. Telehealth chip, photo frame, evidence notes.

teal-line.$description: Border of teal chips and panels; keeps them distinct in greyscale print.

sun.$description: Sunshine accent. The swash under highlighted words, the disc behind Simone's photo, stars and rewards. Ink text only on it (7.1:1); never white text.

sun-deep.$description: Icons on sun-tint (ESDM tile), 4.5:1. Not a text colour: sun tags use ink on sun instead (7.1:1).

sun-ink.$description: Text inside sun-tint chips (6.6:1). AAA: darkened from #7a4a00 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

sun-tint.$description: Butter chip ground ('Community sessions' chip), ESDM tile.

sun-line.$description: Border of sun chips and panels.

butter.$description: Cream section ground. Warm page backgrounds on handouts.

pink.$description: Assessments icon and small accents. Darkened from #e0457b in Oct 2026: 4.5:1 on pink-tint and 5.4:1 on paper, so it also works as text.

pink-line.$description: Border of pink chips and panels.

ink.$description: Headings and strong text on every light ground (12.3:1 or better).

ink-soft.$description: Body copy on paper, purple-tint, teal-tint and butter (6.0:1 or better). AAA: darkened from #5b556b in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

deep.$description: Deep-purple footer and dark bands. Paper or purple-tint text on it.

live-ink.$description: 'Spots available now' text on teal-tint (4.7:1). AAA: darkened from #0f7a52 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

brand-ink.$description: The logo mark AND the practice name, everywhere. Change this one token to recolour both together.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring (3px), always with a 2px paper gap inside it, so it shows on every ground including deep.

trail.$description: Default colour of the footstep trail. Decorative only.

rule.$description: Write-on lines, draw boxes and cut lines on paper: 3:1 or better on paper and every tint, so they survive a mono home printer. Not for decoration.

teal-bright.$description: Older tick circles and heading underline marks on the home page.

teal-deep.$description: Teal button hover; dark teal link text. AAA: darkened from #015a66 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

teal-deeper.$description: Teal text on mint in the 'How it works' steps.

sun-soft.$description: The soft sun disc behind Simone's photo; footer link colour on deep.

butter-deep.$description: Focus outline on dark grounds; warm hover tint.

lilac.$description: Lilac wave and hover tint on the home page.

lilac-bright.$description: Browser theme colour (the phone's address bar) and an old header tint.

purple-light.$description: Side-rail menu borders and progress fade.

pink-deep.$description: Pink pop-up band, tag fill with white text (8.4:1) and chip text on pink-tint (7.1:1). AAA: darkened in Oct 2026.

coral.$description: An old accent on the home page; candidate to remove.

weight.$description: Font weights that carry a design decision.

brand.$description: The practice name beside the logo: Fredoka a touch bolder than the logo's lines, so the two read as one weight.

text.$description: Font sizes. Fluid ones grow smoothly from phone to desktop; the value shown is the desktop one.

xs.$description: Fine print: footer details, crumbs, tags, pop-up notes.

sm.$description: Small UI text: chips, credentials, links in pop-ups.

md.$description: Buttons, menu labels, card titles, list lines in the hero.

lg.$description: Leads under a title; bigger card titles.

xl.$description: The hero's lead line; pop-up titles; Simone's name.

kid.$description: Anything a child reads: instructions, labels, steps. Never under 14pt on paper.

display.$description: The practice name in the home page hero.

title.$description: Page and cover titles. One per page.

wordmark.$description: The practice name set beside or under the logo, at weight-brand so the letters match the logo's line weight.

lead.$description: Intro line under a title, in ink.

followmetherapy.sample: Helping children and their families live their fullest lives.
I'll check whether ESDM suits your child at the initial assessment.
Not sure if you're eligible? Ask me or your doctor.

print-title.$description: 28pt in print. Worksheet and book page titles.

print-kid.$description: 16pt in print. Words a child reads or traces. Never smaller than 14pt.

print-body.$description: 11pt in print. Parent and carer instructions.

followmetherapy.sample: Try this at home three times this week.

print-small.$description: 8.5pt in print. Footer, credits and copyright line. Minimum size for print.

hair.$description: Optical nudges only: an outline's offset, a hairline gap.

1.$description: Icon-to-text nudges; between a label and its note.

2.$description: Gap between chips; between an icon and its words.

3.$description: Gap between list lines; tight padding.

4.$description: Paragraph gap; padding inside small controls.

5.$description: Padding inside notes and pop-up rows.

6.$description: Card padding; gap between a heading and a card.

7.$description: Space before a list label; pop-up padding.

8.$description: Gap between groups inside a section.

10.$description: Space above a note or call to action.

12.$description: Space above a section's closing note.

14.$description: Large gaps: under the hero title.

24.$description: Room for the floating button at the foot of a phone page.

layout.$description: Fluid sizes: each grows smoothly from its phone value (360px wide) to its desktop value (1440px wide), so nothing jumps as the window resizes. The value shown is the desktop one; extensions hold both. Each also has a fixed value for paper (A4 handouts) and book (A5 staple-book pages) under extensions.media, used inside .medium-paper/.fmt-sheet and .medium-book/.fmt-page.

gutter.$description: Space between the page edge and the content.

section.$description: Top and bottom padding of every section band.

section-top.$description: Top padding of a section band, above its title (the wave already adds air).

stack.$description: Space between groups: under a section title, and between the blocks of a worksheet.

group.$description: Space between a heading and the thing it introduces, so they read as one group (always smaller than stack).

grid.$description: Gap between cards in a grid.

measure.$description: Widest a paragraph gets, for comfortable reading.

wave.$description: Height of the wavy edge between section bands.

nav-offset.$description: Gap between the floating menu and the window edge.

rail-gap.$description: Gap either side of the rail; content starts after rail + 2 gaps.

nav-item.$description: A link in the floating top menu. Its tap area reaches past the slim bar to the full 44px.

tile.$description: Small icon tiles; the menu's logo circle.

button.$description: Height of a button. Its radius is half of this (a pill), so a container with a button in its corner gets radius = button/2 + padding + outline.

tile.$description: Icon tiles and photo frames: the same as radius-md, so every tile nests in its container exactly as Simone's photo does (radius-md + card-pad + outline).

card.$description: Service and funding cards; large icon tiles (76px).

pill.$description: Chips, buttons, tags, links in pop-ups.

radius.$description: Corners. Nest rule: a container's corner radius = the radius of whatever sits in its corner + the padding between them + the container's outline, so the two curves run parallel.

outline.$description: The outline on every container that holds an icon, label or note: icon tiles, chips, info notes and their badges, step numbers, the side menu. Always in the container's own line colour (purple-line, teal-line, sun-line, pink-line).

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring width (offset by the same amount). Always in the focus colour.

rest.$description: Cards, buttons and chips at rest.

soft.$description: Floating menus and panels. Screen only: drop shadows on print.

panel.$description: Big white panels on a coloured band (hero, Meet Simone).

glow-purple.$description: A soft glow in the thing's own colour. Purple buttons, the purple step disc, the rail pill, the Contact me button. Screen only.

glow-teal.$description: A soft glow in the thing's own colour. Teal buttons and the teal step disc. Screen only.

glow-sun.$description: A soft glow in the thing's own colour. The yellow step disc. Screen only.

glow-pink.$description: A soft glow in the thing's own colour. The pink step disc. Screen only.

motion.$description: Durations and easings for every transition and entrance. Ambient artwork loops (illustrations, footprints) keep their own longer timings.

ease-standard.$description: Most movement: quick start, gentle stop.

ease-spring.$description: Playful overshoot: hovers, pops, the rail pill.

raised.$description: Content over content (rail links over its pill).

breakpoint.$description: The only window sizes where layout changes. Media queries can't read CSS variables, so tools/check_tokens.py makes sure every @media uses one of these numbers. Between them, everything is fluid.

xs.$description: Small phones: the menu bar spans the width.

sm.$description: Phones: one column; the logo sits above the name.

md.$description: The menu moves from the top bar to the side rail.

shorter.$description: Very short windows (height): pop-ups drop the icon tile.

page-a5.$description: Staple book pages (A4 sheets folded in half).

bleed.$description: Extend any colour that touches a trimmed edge this far past it.

safe-margin.$description: Keep all text and icons this far inside the trim on home-printed sheets.

safe-margin-book.$description: Outer safe margin on staple book pages (allows for creep).

gutter-book.$description: Inner margin from the fold on staple book pages.

rule-write.$description: Line spacing for adult handwriting lines.

rule-kid.$description: Line spacing for a child's handwriting lines.

tone.$description: The four tones and the role each colour plays in them. Fixed meanings: purple = who it's for, teal = telehealth, sun = in person, pink = reports. Components choose a role (component.*), never a colour, so a tone change reaches every component on every product.

tint.$description: Pale fill of chips, tiles and choices.

ink.$description: Text and icons on the tint.

line.$description: Outline of anything static in this tone (chips, notes, headers, tiles).

solid.$description: Full-strength colour: tags, outlines of things you tap, selected choices.

strong.$description: Fill of solid buttons and text of outlined buttons (7:1 with white).

ground.$description: Background of a tinted container in this tone (notes, headers, bands).

component.$description: Component tokens: which tone role (tint, ink, line, solid, strong, strong-hover, ground, icon, on-solid) or which colour/size each part of a shared component takes. Every product reads these: the website and Design System CSS (--<component>-<tone>-<part>), the app (Fmt<Component>Tokens). Change a rule here and it changes everywhere. The parts of each component, and which products implement it, are listed in design/components.json.

line-hover.$description: Outline of a chip that's a link, on hover.

fill-on-ground.$description: A chip sitting on its own tone's ground (an Ages chip on a lilac hero, app bar or note) turns paper so it doesn't vanish.

outline-fill.$description: An outline chip (a plain label on paper): paper with the tone's ink and line.

fill-selected.$description: A filter chip that's chosen: the tone's ink, dark enough for white words in every tone and a big light-to-dark change from paper, so it never relies on hue alone.

ink-selected.$description: Words and icon on a chosen filter chip.

tag.$description: A small solid label above a title (Self-care).

tile.$description: An icon tile: a rounded square, tint ground, icon in the tone.

fill-on-ground.$description: A tile inside a tinted container (a note) is paper.

note.$description: An info note: tinted, outlined, with an icon tile; words centred beside it.

line-hover.$description: Outline of a note that's a link, on hover.

promise-fill.$description: The practice's promise: a paper note in the heading face.

row-fill.$description: A one-line link note set with the contact rows (How your information is handled): paper, deep outline.

head.$description: An activity's header panel (worksheet and app).

panel.$description: A tinted section of a page (Keep a backup): the tone's ground, outlined in its line; its words sit at the text edge.

card.$description: A container you tap (service card, list row). Tappable things are outlined in the solid colour; static ones in the line colour.

done-fill.$description: The tick badge on a row whose activity is done (done is teal everywhere).

choice.$description: A choice tile (tap to choose on screens, circle on paper).

line-selected.$description: Outline of a chosen tile (with a second inner outline, so it never relies on colour alone).

button.$description: A pill button. Solid: the tone's strong colour with white words. Outline: paper with the strong colour.

outline-ink-hover.$description: Words of an outline button on hover (7:1 on the tint).

bar.$description: The app's top bar, tab bar and their waves (and any lilac band edge in an app).

line.$description: Stroke along the bars' curved edges.

brand.$description: The lockup's name on the home screen's bar.

wave.$description: Depth of the wave under the app bar.

crest.$description: How far the tab bar's crest rises over the chosen tab.

swash.$description: The hand-drawn sun underline under one key word.

step.$description: One step, big (the app's routine steps): a disc with the number, teal with a tick when done.

ink.$description: The number and 'Step n of N'.

done-fill.$description: Done: teal (done is teal everywhere, like the tick list).

done-ink.$description: The tick on a done step.

celebrate.$description: The end of a flow: a sun disc with a star.

breathe.$description: The breathing guide: a teal disc that grows and shrinks.

calendar.$description: A week of an activity plan: days across, activities down; each day planned, partly done or done.

planned.$description: A planned day: a ring in the activity's line colour.

partial.$description: Partly done (some steps): the activity's tint inside its ring.
